system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast as a Taijutsu Finisher. This is the ultimate culmination of offensive Taijutsu. As a part of the activation of this jutsu, you must have the 7th Gate: Wonder from the 8 Inner Gates Taijutsu Feat active.

Make 5 Taijutsu attacks against a target. Each attack you make is treated as a shockwave that affects all creatures in a 15-foot-wide, 60 feet line behind your initial target. On a hit, the target creature takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage.
